description_en: Channel benefits are issued as redemption codes. When you generate redemption codes, the quantity of the corresponding benefit is reduced
description_zh: 获取权益兑换码。渠道权益，将以兑换码的形式进行发放和流转。生成兑换码后，相应的权益数量将会扣减
name: GetRedeemCodes

parameters.description_en: Number of redemption codes to generate. Valid values: 1 to 100.
parameters.description_zh: 需要的兑换码数量，取值范围：1~100。
parameters.help_en: Number of redemption codes to generate. Valid values: 1 to 100
parameters.help_zh: 需要的兑换码数量，取值范围：1~100
parameters.name: code_quantity

parameters.description_en: ID of the benefit included in the redemption code. Get this ID by calling [DescribeBenefits](~~2500858~~).
parameters.description_zh: 兑换码包含的权益ID，通过[DescribeBenefits](~~2500858~~)获取。
parameters.help_en: ID of the benefit included in the redemption code. Get this ID by calling https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2500858.html
parameters.help_zh: 兑换码包含的权益ID，通过https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2500858.html获取
parameters.name: benefit_id

parameters.description_en: Request token for the channel service. Get this token by calling [GetRequestToken](~~2500860~~). Each request token can be used only once.
parameters.description_zh: 渠道服务请求凭证，可通过[GetRequestToken](~~2500860~~)获取，每个渠道服务请求凭证使用有效次数：1次。
parameters.help_en: Request token for the channel service. Get this token by calling https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2500860.html. Each request token can be used only once
parameters.help_zh: 渠道服务请求凭证，可通过https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2500860.html获取，每个渠道服务请求凭证使用有效次数：1次
parameters.name: request_token
